myinfo.alabamavotes.gov.en: My Voting Information (Alabama Secretary of State)
myinfo.alabamavotes.gov.es: el buscador oficial de la Secretaría de Estado de Alabama

reg_deadline.en: Registration closed Monday, October 19, 2026. Alabama has no Election Day registration.
reg_deadline.es: El registro cerró el lunes 19 de octubre de 2026. Alabama no tiene registro el Día de las Elecciones.
reg_deadline.quote: Voter registration is open all year, except during the 14 days prior to an election and on Election Day.

mail_request.en: Your county's Absentee Election Manager must receive your absentee application by Tuesday, October 27, 2026, if you mail it, or by Thursday, October 29, 2026, if you bring it in person.
mail_request.es: La oficina de voto en ausencia de tu condado (Absentee Election Manager) debe recibir tu solicitud a más tardar el martes 27 de octubre de 2026 si la mandas por correo, o el jueves 29 de octubre de 2026 si la llevas en persona.
mail_request.quote: The absentee ballot application must be received by the Absentee Election Manager by the 7th day prior to the election if delivered by mail and the 5th day prior to the election if delivered by hand. EMERGENCY ABSENTEE VOTING applications can be made after the absentee deadline but no later than 5 PM on the day before the election, if the voter: is required by an employer under unforeseen circumstances to be unavailable at the polls on the day of the election is a caregiver of a person who requires emergency treatment by licensed physician within five days before an election has a family member to the second degree of kinship by affinity or consanguinity die within five days before an election MEDICAL EMERGENCY ABSENTEE VOTING applications can be made by a voter who has a medical emergency requiring treatment from a licensed physician within 5 days of an election. During that 5 day period, the medical emergency absentee ballot application and the voted absentee ballot must be returned no later than noon on the day the election is held.
mail_request.en_after: Regular absentee applications closed October 29, 2026. An emergency in the last five days? If your employer unexpectedly needs you at work, a close family member dies, or someone you care for needs emergency treatment, you can apply for an emergency absentee ballot until 5 p.m. on Monday, November 2. If you need emergency medical treatment yourself, your application and ballot are due by noon on Election Day. Everyone else votes at their polling place, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes regulares de voto en ausencia cerraron el 29 de octubre de 2026. ¿Tuviste una emergencia en los últimos cinco días? Si tu empleador de repente te necesita en el trabajo, muere un familiar cercano o alguien a quien cuidas necesita tratamiento de emergencia, puedes solicitar una boleta de emergencia para votar en ausencia hasta las 5 p. m. del lunes 2 de noviembre. Si tú necesitas tratamiento médico de emergencia, tu solicitud y tu boleta deben entregarse a más tardar al mediodía del Día de las Elecciones. Todos los demás votan en su lugar de votación, de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m.

mail_return.en: A mailed ballot must reach your county's Absentee Election Manager by noon on Tuesday, November 3. A postmark isn't enough. Bringing it yourself? Get it to that office by closing time on Monday, November 2, 2026, and no later than 5 p.m.
mail_return.es: Una boleta enviada por correo debe llegar a la oficina de voto en ausencia de tu condado (Absentee Election Manager) a más tardar al mediodía del martes 3 de noviembre. El matasellos no basta. ¿La vas a llevar tú? Entrégala en esa oficina antes de que cierre el lunes 2 de noviembre de 2026, a más tardar a las 5 p. m.
mail_return.quote: An absentee ballot returned by mail must be received by the Absentee Election Manager no later than noon on election day. If hand-delivered, the ballot must be in the office of the Absentee Election Manager by the close of business (but no later than 5 p.m.) on the day prior to the election.
mail_return.en_after: A mailed ballot must reach your county's Absentee Election Manager by noon on Tuesday, November 3. A postmark isn't enough. In-person return ended at closing time on Monday, November 2.
mail_return.es_after: Una boleta enviada por correo debe llegar a la oficina de voto en ausencia de tu condado (Absentee Election Manager) a más tardar al mediodía del martes 3 de noviembre. El matasellos no basta. La entrega en persona terminó al cierre del lunes 2 de noviembre.

early_hours.notes: Alabama has no early voting period (states.js kind 'none'); there are no early voting hours to state.

cure.notes: No absentee signature or witness cure process found on sos.alabama.gov or in the 2026 Voter Guide. The only post-election fix found is showing photo ID by 5 p.m. the Friday after the election (in id.without).

in_person.en: Alabama has no early voting, so most people vote at their polling place on Election Day. If you qualify for an absentee ballot, you can also visit your county's Absentee Election Manager to ask for one. In most counties that's the circuit clerk.
in_person.es: Alabama no tiene votación anticipada, así que la mayoría vota en su lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones. Si cumples los requisitos para votar en ausencia, también puedes ir a la oficina de voto en ausencia de tu condado (Absentee Election Manager), para pedir tu boleta. En la mayoría de los condados es la oficina del secretario del tribunal de circuito (Circuit Clerk).
in_person.quote: To obtain an absentee ballot, write or visit the local Absentee Election Manager (usually the Circuit Clerk), request an absentee ballot, and provide the following:

first_time.en: Just registered? Watch for a voter ID postcard from your county Board of Registrars. That's your sign you're registered. Not sure? Call your Board of Registrars or check at alabamavotes.gov.
first_time.es: ¿Te acabas de registrar? Espera una tarjeta postal de votante (Voter ID card) de la junta de registro de tu condado (Board of Registrars). Esa es la señal de que ya estás registrado. ¿No estás seguro? Llama a la junta de registro de tu condado o revisa en alabamavotes.gov.
first_time.quote: This notification will typically be a voter identification postcard confirming that you are registered to vote.

locator_label.en: My Voting Information (Alabama Secretary of State)
locator_label.es: Buscador oficial de lugares de votación (Secretaría de Estado de Alabama)

rule.en: Your voter ID card, a postcard from your county Board of Registrars, lists your precinct and polling place. You can also look it up with My Voting Information on the Secretary of State's site.
rule.es: Tu tarjeta de votante (Voter ID card), una tarjeta postal de la junta de registro de tu condado (Board of Registrars), dice tu precinto y tu lugar de votación. También puedes buscarlo en el buscador oficial de la Secretaría de Estado (My Voting Information).
rule.quote: The Voter ID card is a postcard which includes the voter’s precinct information and polling location.

en: Free Alabama Photo Voter ID card
Employee ID from the federal government, the State of Alabama, or an Alabama county, city, board or other entity of the state
Student or employee ID from a public or private college or university in Alabama
Student or employee ID from a state college or university in any other state
Any other federal or state-issued photo ID, such as a pistol permit with a photo
es: Licencia de conducir de Alabama (la tarjeta física)
Identificación de Alabama para no conductores (la tarjeta física)
Credencial gratuita de votante con foto de Alabama (Alabama Photo Voter ID card)
Identificación de empleado del gobierno federal, del estado de Alabama o de un condado, ciudad, junta u otra entidad del estado de Alabama
Identificación de estudiante o empleado de una universidad pública o privada de Alabama
Identificación de estudiante o empleado de una universidad estatal de cualquier otro estado
Cualquier otra identificación con foto del gobierno federal o de un estado, como un permiso de pistola con foto
accepted.quote: A voter must present one of the following forms of identification before they will be permitted to vote.
accepted.notes: Digital license mention removed Oct 28: the SOS release (node 3642) says digital IDs are not accepted for voting; see id.expired notes.

expired.en: Bring the physical card. The Secretary of State says digital driver's licenses and other electronic IDs aren't accepted for voting. An Alabama driver's license or non-driver ID still works if it expired less than 60 days ago.
expired.es: Lleva la tarjeta física. La Secretaría de Estado dice que las licencias de conducir digitales y otras identificaciones electrónicas no se aceptan para votar. La licencia de conducir o la identificación para no conductores de Alabama todavía sirve si se venció hace menos de 60 días.
expired.quote: Valid Driver's License (not expired or has been expired less than 60 days) Valid Non-driver ID (not expired or has been expired less than 60 days) ... No Digital IDs: Digital driver licenses or other electronic forms of identification are not accepted for voting purposes. Voters must present a physical form of photo ID.
expired.notes: Conflict: the 2026 Voter Guide PDF, the 2026 Photo Voter ID Guide and the SOS valid-IDs page still list the ALEA Digital Driver's License. The SOS release (node 3642, undated) says digital IDs are not accepted, and HB110 (2026 RS, enrolled; passed House Jan 27 and concurred Mar 12, 2026; effective Oct 1, 2026) says a digital license may not be produced in place of a physical one as voter photo ID under Section 17-9-30. The page follows the release and the bill.

without.en: No photo ID? You can still vote a regular ballot if your name is on the voter list and two election officials identify you. If they can't, you vote a provisional ballot and have until 5 p.m. on Friday, November 6, 2026, to bring a photo ID to your county Board of Registrars. Need an ID? The Board of Registrars gives out the Alabama Photo Voter ID card for free.
without.es: ¿No tienes identificación con foto? Todavía puedes votar con una boleta regular si tu nombre está en la lista de votantes y dos funcionarios electorales te identifican. Si no pueden, votas con una boleta provisional y tienes hasta las 5 p. m. del viernes 6 de noviembre de 2026 para llevar una identificación con foto a la junta de registro de tu condado (Board of Registrars). ¿Necesitas una? Esa junta da gratis la credencial de votante con foto de Alabama (Alabama Photo Voter ID card).
without.quote: No Photo ID at Polling Place and Unable to be Positively Identified by Two Election Officials - The voter has until 5 P.M. on the Friday following the election to submit a valid form of photo ID to the Board of Registrars.

who.en: You can vote absentee in Alabama if you:
who.es: Puedes votar en ausencia en Alabama si:
who.quote: A voter may cast an absentee ballot if he or she

en: expect to be away from your county on Election Day
are ill or have a physical disability that keeps you from getting to the polling place
are 65 or older or have a disability, and a physical condition keeps you from reaching your assigned polling place
are a registered Alabama voter living outside your county, such as a member of the armed forces, someone working outside the U.S., a college student, or the spouse or child of one
are an appointed election officer or poll watcher at a polling place other than your own
expect to work a required shift of 10 hours or more during polling hours
are a caregiver for a close family member who is confined to their home
are in prison or jail and haven't been convicted of a felony involving moral turpitude
es: esperas estar fuera de tu condado el Día de las Elecciones
estás enfermo o tienes una discapacidad física que no te deja llegar al lugar de votación
tienes 65 años o más o tienes una discapacidad, y una condición física no te deja llegar a tu lugar de votación

eres votante registrado de Alabama y vives fuera de tu condado, por ejemplo si estás en las fuerzas armadas, trabajas fuera de EE. UU., eres estudiante universitario o eres cónyuge o hijo de una de esas personas
eres funcionario electoral u observador designado en un lugar de votación que no es el tuyo
esperas trabajar un turno obligatorio de 10 horas o más durante el horario de votación
cuidas a un familiar cercano que no puede salir de su casa
estás en prisión o en la cárcel y no te han condenado por un delito grave de vileza moral (felony involving moral turpitude)
who_list.quote: EXPECTS TO WORK A REQUIRED SHIFT, 10-HOURS OR MORE, that coincides with polling hours

witness.en: Sign the affidavit on your ballot envelope in front of a notary or two witnesses who are 18 or older. Without that, the ballot can't be counted. Online or remote notarizing isn't allowed.
witness.es: Firma la declaración del sobre de tu boleta frente a un notario o dos testigos de 18 años o más. Sin eso, la boleta no se puede contar. No se permite notarizar en línea ni a distancia.
witness.quote: An absentee ballot cannot be counted unless the affidavit is notarized or has the signatures of two witnesses. Electronic or remote notarization is not permitted.

cure.en: Check the affidavit envelope before you seal it: your signature, and two witnesses or a notary. Alabama has no way to count a ballot with a deficient envelope.
cure.es: Revisa el sobre con la declaración jurada antes de cerrarlo: tu firma, y dos testigos o un notario. Alabama no tiene forma de contar una boleta con un sobre incompleto.
cure.quote: There is no statutory authority by which the board of registrars can approve the counting of an absentee ballot with a deficient affidavit envelope.
cure.notes: Guide sits in the election-2024 folder; the 2026 Voter Guide repeats the witness rule.

dropbox.en: Send your ballot by U.S. Mail or a commercial carrier, or hand it in yourself at your county's Absentee Election Manager. With an emergency absentee ballot, someone you name can deliver it. No one else can return it for you.
dropbox.es: Manda tu boleta por el Servicio Postal de EE. UU. o por una empresa de mensajería, o entrégala en persona en la oficina de voto en ausencia de tu condado (Absentee Election Manager). Con una boleta de emergencia para votar en ausencia, una persona que tú designes puede entregarla. Nadie más puede devolverla por ti.
dropbox.quote: The voter has only the following legal ways to return the absentee ballot: forwards the absentee ballot by U.S. Mail forwards the absentee ballot by commercial carrier personally hands their own absentee ballot to the absentee election manager (or delivers by a designee in the case of emergency absentee voting)

gear.en: You can wear campaign buttons or T-shirts into the polling place in Alabama. Just don't hang around or leave campaign materials behind. Campaigners have to stay at least 30 feet from the entrance.
gear.es: En Alabama puedes entrar al lugar de votación con botones o camisetas de campaña. Solo no te quedes merodeando ni dejes propaganda de campaña. Quienes hacen campaña deben quedarse a por lo menos 30 pies de la entrada.
gear.quote: Can I wear campaign buttons or t-shirts with political advertisements into the polling place? Yes. However, you should not loiter or leave any campaign materials in the polling place.

phone.en: You can bring your phone if you don't disturb other voters. Inside, you can take a picture of your own ballot or of you with it, but no other photos or video, and never of another voter's ballot. Take your sticker selfie outside. Nothing official covers photos of an absentee ballot, so ask your county's Absentee Election Manager.
phone.es: Puedes llevar tu teléfono si no molestas a los demás votantes. Adentro puedes tomarle una foto a tu propia boleta o tomarte una foto con ella, pero ninguna otra foto ni video, y nunca de la boleta de otro votante. Tómate la selfie con tu sticker afuera. Ninguna fuente oficial habla de fotos de una boleta de voto en ausencia, así que pregunta en la oficina de voto en ausencia de tu condado (Absentee Election Manager).
phone.quote: However, voters are permitted to take a picture of or with their ballot, as long as they do not disclose the content of any other voter's ballot or disrupt the voting process. ... If your cell phone has a camera, you cannot take photographs or film video inside the polling place.

line.en: Get in line before 7 p.m. Anyone who tries to join the line after 7 p.m. can't vote.
line.es: Fórmate en la fila antes de las 7 p. m. Quien intente formarse después de las 7 p. m. no puede votar.
line.quote: Anyone who attempts to join the voting line after 7:00 P.M. shall not be permitted to vote.

tradition.en: For the November 3, 2026 general election, Alabama's Secretary of State released newly designed America 250 I Voted stickers, marking the country's 250th anniversary.
tradition.es: Para la elección general del 3 de noviembre de 2026, la Secretaría de Estado de Alabama sacó stickers de I Voted con un diseño nuevo de America 250, por los 250 años del país.
tradition.quote: Wes Allen, Alabama's Secretary of State is announcing the release of newly designed America 250 "I Voted" stickers

provisional.en: If your name isn't on the voter list and the county can't confirm your registration, you can vote a provisional ballot. It counts if your county Board of Registrars confirms you're qualified to vote at that polling place.
provisional.es: Si tu nombre no aparece en la lista de votantes y el condado no puede confirmar tu registro, puedes votar con una boleta provisional. Cuenta si la junta de registro de tu condado (Board of Registrars) confirma que puedes votar en ese lugar de votación.
provisional.quote: Voter Name Not on Poll List - The provisional ballot will be counted if the county Board of Registrars are able to confirm that the person casting the ballot is a duly qualified elector of the polling place where the ballot was cast.

line.en: You can still vote. Everyone in line at 7 p.m. gets to vote before the polling place closes. If you join the line after 7 p.m., you can't vote.
line.es: Todavía puedes votar. Todas las personas que están en la fila a las 7 p. m. pueden votar antes de que cierre el lugar de votación. Si llegas a la fila después de las 7 p. m., ya no puedes votar.
line.quote: Each polling place is open for voting from 7:00 am to 7:00 pm: All voters who are in line to vote at 7:00 pm shall be permitted to vote before closing the polling place. Anyone who attempts to join the voting line after 7:00 pm shall not be permitted to vote.
line.notes: Oct 31 pass 4: read with pdftotext from the Secretary of State's Alabama Polling Official Guide 2026 (03/2026).

track.en: Check your absentee ballot's status with My Voting Information on the Secretary of State's site.
track.es: Revisa el estado de tu boleta de voto en ausencia en el buscador oficial de la Secretaría de Estado (My Voting Information).
track.quote: Confirm your registration status, ballot status, polling location, and address.

late_mail.en: It may be. Your county's Absentee Election Manager must receive a mailed ballot by noon on Tuesday, November 3, and a postmark doesn't count. You can still hand your own ballot to that office by close of business, and no later than 5 p.m., on Monday, November 2. Mail, a commercial carrier, or your own hand delivery are the only legal ways to return it.
late_mail.es: Puede que sí. El administrador electoral de voto en ausencia de tu condado (Absentee Election Manager) debe recibir la boleta por correo a más tardar al mediodía del martes 3 de noviembre, y el matasellos no cuenta. Todavía puedes entregar tu propia boleta en esa oficina antes del cierre, y a más tardar a las 5 p. m., del lunes 2 de noviembre. El correo, una empresa de mensajería o tu entrega en persona son las únicas formas legales de devolverla.
late_mail.quote: The voter has only the following legal ways to return the absentee ballot: forwards the absentee ballot by U.S. Mail forwards the absentee ballot by commercial carrier personally hands their own absentee ballot to the absentee election manager (or delivers by a designee in the case of emergency absentee voting) VOTING DEADLINE An absentee ballot returned by mail must be received by the Absentee Election Manager no later than noon on election day. If hand-delivered, the ballot must be in the office of the Absentee Election Manager by the close of business (but no later than 5 p.m.) on the day prior to the election.
late_mail.notes: Pass 2 Oct 30, read by curl. Emergency absentee voters may use a designee (same page).
late_mail.en_after: Yes, by mail. Your county's Absentee Election Manager must receive a mailed ballot by noon on Tuesday, November 3, and a postmark doesn't count. Hand delivery ended at close of business on Monday, November 2.
late_mail.es_after: Sí, por correo. El administrador electoral de voto en ausencia de tu condado (Absentee Election Manager) debe recibir la boleta por correo a más tardar al mediodía del martes 3 de noviembre, y el matasellos no cuenta. La entrega en persona terminó al cierre del lunes 2 de noviembre.

notes: Read October 21, 2026 with curl on sos.alabama.gov: the 2026 Voter Guide PDF, Absentee Voting Information, the Alabama Votes FAQ, the Photo Voter ID page, and myinfo.alabamavotes.gov/voterview (page labeled VoterView; the Voter Guide calls the tool 'My Voting Information'). The Voter Guide's deadline chart labels the mail ballot row 'must be postmarked no later than noon', but its text, its dates list ('Absentee ballots returned by mail must be received by noon') and the SOS absentee page all say received by noon; the file uses received. Absentee voting starts 'no later than' September 9 per the guide's chart. Photo rule: the FAQ says camera phones can't take photos or video inside, but in the same FAQ voters may take a picture 'of or with their ballot'; polls_rules.phone keeps both. Sticker tradition not found. States.js has AL verified as kind 'none'; nothing here contradicts it. October 28: Perplexity review checked on sos.alabama.gov. Digital ID: the page now follows the SOS release that digital IDs are not accepted (HB110, effective Oct 1, 2026, says the same); the 2026 Voter Guide and valid-IDs page still list the digital license and conflict. Hand delivery is by close of business, no later than 5 p.m., Nov 2. Emergency and medical emergency absentee routes added after the Oct 29 deadline. Unverified: the two-official affidavit detail (not in the Voter Guide text read).

hours.en: Polling places are open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: On Election Day, polls will be open 7 am to 7 pm.
